packages.name: Speak Selection
packages.summary: Speaks selected text in a Voicebox cloned voice on your speakers.

packages.name: Generate WAV from Text
packages.summary: Turns a selected text file into a spoken WAV saved beside it.

packages.name: Transcribe Audio
packages.summary: Transcribes selected audio with Voicebox Whisper to a sidecar .txt.

packages.name: New Cloned Voice
packages.summary: Creates a cloned Voicebox profile from selected audio and a transcript.

packages.name: Import Voice ZIP
packages.summary: Imports an exported Voicebox profile zip into the local app.

packages.name: Add Sample to Voice
packages.summary: Adds another reference recording to an existing cloned voice.

packages.name: Import Audio into Voicebox
packages.summary: Uploads a local recording into Voicebox History.

packages.name: Set Profile Avatar
packages.summary: Sets a Finder image as a Voicebox voice card avatar.

packages.name: Export Voice
packages.summary: Exports a chosen voice profile zip to Downloads.

packages.name: Load or Unload Qwen
packages.summary: Loads Qwen 1.7B into memory or unloads the TTS model.

packages.name: Clear Voicebox Cache
packages.summary: Clears Voicebox generation cache after a confirm dialog.

packages.name: Compose in Character
packages.summary: Copies a fresh in-character line for a chosen voice to the clipboard.

packages.name: Stream Speak
packages.summary: Speaks selected text via stream playback, falling back to /speak.
